shared_policy: Every original policy sentence preserved verbatim; only headings and paragraph boundaries changed. One canonical source, 13 standalone local copies.
reference_ledger: One canonical source, three byte-identical standalone local copies.
historical_artifacts: All pre-existing evaluation files unchanged except constructive-inquiry/manifest.json resolution metadata; expected hashes unchanged.
tools: Python 3.9+ standard library; 23 temporary-repository unit tests passed. Checks cover structural integrity, drift, escapes, missing history, exact archive bytes/modes, checksum matching, dirty-worktree and overwrite refusal.
